Lina G.: Heads up — NimbleCloud reported duplicate invoices and one duplicate has no compute/GPU lines. Customer called this morning.
Raj Patel: Oof. Which job ran and why duplicated? :grimacing:
Lina G.: Nightly batch retried after a transient DB timeout. Retry wrapper didn’t clear the staging temp rows, so second run consumed leftover records. Also we renamed compute SKU last week (reserved_gpu -> reserved_capacity_gpu) and the old mapper filtered it out.
finance-bot: billing-job-processor: invoice-generation failed for batch 2026-03-20T02:00Z (timeout) — automatic retry scheduled in 30s
Sasha M.: I merged a mapper patch earlier: billing/mapper@a12f that accepts both SKU keys. If retry ran before merge that explains the missing compute lines.
Lina G.: Retry created inv_2026_NIMBLE_1002 and inv_2026_NIMBLE_1003. 1002 looks correct, 1003 is duplicate, missing compute lines and support fee doubled. I attached both invoice IDs to ticket FIN-4317.
Eileen: Financial exposure estimate? Need to know if we issue credits or voids.
Lina G.: Quick numbers: missing compute on duplicate is ~$9,200 undercharge on one copy, duplicate added phantom support of $1,150 on the other. Customer effectively sees two invoices summing +$1,150 vs expected single invoice. Recommend voiding the bad duplicate and posting a $9,200 credit on the final invoice.
Raj Patel: Agreed. Action items: 1) Void inv_2026_NIMBLE_1003 — accounting approval required. 2) Regenerate canonical invoice and resend. 3) Post manual credit for $9,200. 4) Sweep staging to avoid more dupes.
Lina G.: To find affected staging rows run: ```sql
SELECT staging_id, customer_id, sku, amount, created_at FROM invoice_staging
WHERE batch_id = '2026-03-20-02' AND processed = false;
```
Sasha M.: Also add a small cleanup job to drop temp rows older than 10m before retry. I can open a PR for the retry wrapper.
Eileen: I'll prepare the accounting approval note and flag for weekend void if needed.
Raj Patel: Assigning: Lina — customer comms & ticket update; Sasha — PR for retry wrapper + mapper sanity check; Eileen — accounting approval; Finance ops — do the SQL sweep and confirm no other invoices were impacted.
Lina G.: Noted. I'll update FIN-4317 with the SQL output and attach the invoice PDFs.
Sasha M.: FYI I confirmed mapper change was deployed at 01:45Z, retry at 02:01Z so fix came after generation. Adding a post-deploy integration test to cover SKU aliases.
finance-bot: ticket FIN-4317 updated by Lina G.; status set to investigation
